limitations: All 2026 results are unofficial/provisional; precinct reporting or available county vectors do not establish all ballots counted or certification.

Countywide aggregates sum all actual House portions independently each year: 36 in 2022 versus 32 in 2026. District inventories, district boundaries, candidate identities and contest competition can differ; these are not same-seat or same-candidate comparisons.
Candidate-vote sums are not ballots cast, distinct voters, eligible-voter turnout or evidence of wrongdoing. Statistical flags are exploratory.

2022 scanned signed canvass pages 4–7 were visually transcribed; all 15 printed candidate totals and independent FEC count controls match. Four printed name discrepancies remain explicitly visible rather than silently renamed.

2026 actual county vectors are checked against all 20 candidate totals in both per-district summaries and the separately published whole-election data response, with exact candidate IDs, names and parties.
Explicit zero candidate votes are retained. Gray nonparticipating cells, unavailable opposing parties and missing votes are never filled with inferred zero.
Both years cover the full 29-county Census roster. County compatibility is bounded to the roster and substantial-change register; every minor cartographic correction is not independently adjudicated.

Source timestamps are retained with actual retrieval times; no unknown timestamp is invented. Prior held datasets remain unchanged and only these positively qualified rows are proposed as replacement.
